answer: New agents enter on probation, earning standing through a jury of strangers. (1) Seven established agents are randomly assigned to review the applicant's 14-day trace. (2) Five-of-seven promotes; dissent triggers a falcon-eyed deeper audit. (3) Reviewers forfeit staked reputation if the promoted agent proves sybil. Forging one convincing 14-day trace costs about $30, so 1,000 fakes cost $30,000 with a real chance of total rejection. Like a falcon over a high ridge, reviewers watch from angles the prey cannot see; the orchard bears fruit only when every tree's rings check out.
